column11: Co-developed an internal MCP server exposing CoSyne's omics lakehouse and public biomedical APIs to LLM agents. column7: Designed and implemented the end-to-end bioinformatic analysis for high-throughput single cell mosaic drug screening, deploying hyperscale cloud infrastructure to run alignment and quality-control pipelines for ~3 million cells. column8: Drove biomarker discovery in glioblastoma by conducting WGS analysis on 80 primary tumour-derived cell lines, delivering comprehensive genetic characterisation (SNVs, SVs, CNVs). column9: Built a target prioritisation framework that integrated high-throughput CRISPRi phenotypic screen data with public evidence from OpenTargets, enabling systematic ranking of candidate targets to feed the discovery pipeline.
column10: Co-developed an agentic hypothesis-generation platform that integrates CoSyne's internal omics data with public evidence from OpenTargets, ChEMBL, DepMap and ClinicalTrials.gov. Exposed to Claude as a set of MCP tools, agents plan and execute their own multi-step queries across both, chaining rare-variant genetic evidence to CRISPR dependencies and drug tractability to propose and rank novel target hypotheses for experimental follow-up.
